correctness.rationale: Reconstructed the 60-vertex, 90-edge graph of diameter 9 from icosahedral darts. Independent exact enumeration at r2 gives 802 nonempty faces, f=(60,270,340,120,12), 375 acyclic matched pairs, 2100 directed Hasse incidences, critical cells 4 in dim0, 15 in dim1, 33 in dim2; r3 gives 6462 faces, f=(60,510,1540,2190,1572,530,60), 3226 matched pairs and 25860 incidences, critical 2,4,4 in dims0,1,2. In both cases the triangle relations eliminate every one-skeleton generator (270 or 510 edges; 6 or 4 sweeps), proving pi1=0. Two-dimensional Morse CW reductions with Euler characteristics 22 and 2 then give wedges 21 S2 and one S2 by Hurewicz and Whitehead; r1 graph cycle rank 90-60+1=31. Independent exact F2 boundary ranks for radii2..6 are (d2,d3,beta2)=(211,108,21),(451,1088,1),(751,3708,1),(1051,8268,1),(1351,15949,0); inspected source verifier explicitly constructs the 116-triangle polyhedral cycle and checks non-boundary r2..5, boundary r6, fixing 20 [2,3) and one [2,6) intervals. These ranks concern only H2 and do not assert later homotopy types.
